art_sections.description: The art database's sections as stored (S-0007), by section name.

colour_add.description:
The colour-adjustment table (S-0006 claim 2): 16 red, green, blue
tints.

colours.description: Imported colour definitions in definition-position order (S-0103).

import.description: Where imported data came from (informational, not hashed).

ini_globals.description: Imported game-wide sections, layered (S-0006), by section name.

ini_globals_derived.description:
Game-wide values the layering computed rather than copied (S-0006
claim 5: extra-light values truncated on re-read, in thousandths),
by section name; such keys are absent from `ini_globals`.

registries.description:
Imported type names per kind, in registration order (S-0004): the
position is the registration index.

sides.description: Imported sides in index order (S-0004 claim 9).

sim.description:
Simulation data: typed fields of the user's data and our own
(converted by the importer, patchable by mods).

types.description: Imported types per kind, by type name.

Art.description: Art looked up for a type (S-0007), for one theater. Render data.

building_sprites.description: Other sprites of a building, by role (claim 11).

flags.description: The art section's flags in force.

notes.description: Notes on cases the specs leave open.

sprite.description: Sprite file seen in play, if any (claims 5 to 15).

voxels.description: Voxel parts found, by role (claims 16 to 20).

BehaviourProps.description: A behaviour's properties (S-0215 claims 6 and 16 to 21).

aa_rate.description:
`AARate`, game minutes (already reset to the rate where S-0215 claim
21 says).

foundation.description: Art `Foundation`, width and height in cells.

Decimal.description:
A decimal written as text, `-?digits[.digits][e±digits][%]`, whose value
is the one S-0003 gives that text (claims 6 and 7).

General.description:
Game-wide values (keys of `[General]`, `[AI]`, `[IQ]`, `[AudioVisual]`,
the combat-damage section and `[MultiplayerDialogSettings]`).

iq_auto_crush.description: `[IQ] AutoCrush` (S-0210 claim 11; the original's computer houses only).

quirks.description:
Quirk switches of the simulation; absent ones take the original's
behaviour.

game.description: Kind of game the layers were applied for (`skirmish` or `campaign`).

incomplete_registries.description:
Kinds whose registries may lack types created by reference that no
approved spec describes yet (Q-0005).

quirks.description: Quirk switches in force, by name.

theater.description: Theater the art was looked up for.

art.description: Art looked up for the import's theater (render data).

created.description: What created it: `list`, or the reference that did.

derived.description:
Values the layering computed rather than copied (S-0006 claim 5:
light values in thousandths, truncated on re-read); such keys are
absent from `ini`.

ini.description: Layered keys as stored INI text (S-0006 claims 3 and 4).

reads.description: The layers whose section it read (S-0006 claim 7).

reset.description:
Keys that hold their reset value (S-0006 claim 5); the value is the
engine default the owning spec states.

side.description: For a country: its side index (S-0004 claim 9).

origin.description: Where it was found: an archive path or `loose`.

LandRow.description:
One land type's row (S-0211 claim 2): multipliers per locomotion class and
the buildable flag. A present row was given by some rules layer; its
missing keys are 1.0 and *no*.

Object.description: An object (our own format). Fields without a spec carry no default.

owners.description: Owners that may build it (a set).

sight.description: Sight, a decimal with a unit (`"4c"`).

ObjectKind.description: A kind of object (our own format).

has_art.description:
Whether the type has artwork or a cell animation (S-0009 claim 12),
as the importer's art lookup found.

land.description:
`Land`; absent: clear (S-0211 claim 4; `<none>` is read as clear by
the importer, with a warning).

ProjectileType.description: A projectile's simulation fields read by M3 rules.

Quirks.description: The quirk switches. Absent fields take the original's behaviour.

air_death_fall_generic_follow_up.description: The falling air death has the generic completion follow-up.

cell_layer_split_on_uneven_deck.description: On a deck over uneven ground, objects come from the deck layer and the record from the ground layer.

cheer_memory_spans_session.description: The last accepted cheer tick carries over between games of a session.

chop_rounding.description: Every floating-point result rounds toward zero (the original's program-wide mode); off: round to nearest, ties to even.

chrono_flash_keeps_order_block.description: A chrono flash restores the order block in force when it started, so a block from game start or an earlier run outlasts it.

cleanup_skips_next_house.description: The unused-house cleanup keeps the house after a removed one.

cliff_back_case_sets.description: Behind a cliff, row 1 of claim 5 becomes rock whatever its land type.

coarse_limit_records_cost.description: A coarse route found at the pending limit still sets the sector's cost.

corridor_free_part_unusable_cells.description: Cells of an unusable category belong to the free part.

corridor_split_probe.description: Whether the progress sector is split is decided at the probe cell.

cow_idle.description: The hard-coded cow type's idle action can scatter it.

crush_slowdown_counts_self.description: The driving vehicle counts itself as a vehicle in the cell it drives into.

crush_slowdown_first_overlay.description: Ship and walking-vehicle crush slowdown is set by the overlay type of registration index 0.

crush_slowdown_ground_layer.description: The crush slowdown looks at the ground layer whichever layer the vehicle is in.

crush_slowdown_persists.description: The crush-slowdown state ends only when the vehicle next crushes an overlay.

crushable_overlay_stays.description: A crushed crushable overlay that is not a wall stays in its cell.

crusher_entry_ground_layer.description: Row VR2 reads the first vehicle of the ground layer even when the deck layer counts.

crusher_overlay_index0_clear.description: A crusher reads obstacle outcomes as clear in cells whose overlay has registration index 0.

detonate_in_planter_name.description: A detonate order is issued in the planter's house's name.

drive_brake_floor_raises.description: Within the slowdown distance the braking floor raises a slower vehicle to the floor.

drive_curve_chaining_passive_only.description: Only passive vehicles chain two-cell curves.

drive_subpoint_compounding.description: The step towards the next track point is taken from the current, possibly interpolated, position.

drive_track_end_cap.description: A tick finishes at most one track if it began without one, two if it began on one.

fire_frame_by_stance.description: The fire frame is chosen by stance and weapon, not by the playing kind.

first_comment_only.description: Only the type's first idle comment sound is used.

flatten_straight_run_v.description: Some straight runs open a V that flattening replaces.

flatten_threat_start_cell.description: Flattening reads the threat value at the new steps' first cell.

fraidycat_fear_ignores_fearless.description: A fearless fraidycat still gets its fear set by a known attacker.

hijack_truce_harvester_check.description: The harvester-truce exception of row I15 never applies.

hover_needs_nonzero_start.description: The hover substitution needs a hover entry starting at a frame other than 0.

infantry_facing_sector_skew.description: Infantry facing groups are skewed 1024 facing units counter-clockwise.

infantry_fixed_turn_rate.description: Infantry bodies turn at the fixed rate 127.

named_deploy_area_fire.description: The deploy area-fire rule singles out one infantry type by name.

narrow_map_partial_pass.description: On a map of width 1 the cell pass visits part of the map.

nearby_centre_twice.description: The nearby-cell search examines its centre twice.

negative_level_floor_raised.description: The level base below level 0 is one lepton higher.

observer_position_handoff.description: An observer's drawn position is handed to the next player needing one.

occupancy_house_side_positions_only.description: The infantry house clears when no side position stays taken.

occupancy_house_stale.description: The infantry house stays that of the last infantry unit to mark, even after it left.

occupancy_override_hides_later_blockers.description: An overriding occupant hides blockers listed after it.

omnicrusher_needs_crusher.description: The omni-crusher flag alone makes no vehicle a crusher.

one_sided_building_distance.description: The building reduction applies only to the second object of a distance.

opposite_facing_reversal.description: The close case reverses the occupant's facing by 32767, not 32768.

override_suspends_queued.description: An override suspends the queued behaviour when one is queued.

passability_laser_fence_lost.description: Laser-fence sections leave the passability category alone.

passability_wheel_column.description: The passability category judges every class by the wheel column.

path_congestion_toggle.description: Congestion marks follow the parity of each cell's count.

path_no_reopen.description: A recorded search pair keeps its first cost and is never reopened.

path_refresh_keeps_old_step.description: A path recomputed as the last step begins keeps the old step and drops the new path's first.

path_search_10000_failure.description: A search that reaches the destination after exactly 10000 expansions fails.

pending_order_limit.description: Each house's pending list holds at most 128 orders.

permadisguise_attack_cursor.description: A permanently disguised target passes the disguise rule.

prone_attack_state_persists.description: A prone unit stays in the attack state and can fire again without a new firing sequence.

prone_noncrawler_speedup.description: A prone unit whose type cannot crawl walks half as fast again.

queued_move_sleeps.description: Queued move and attack move are processed as sleep.

ramp_shape_zero.description: A ramp-range tile of shape 0 becomes the tile just before the ramp range.

random_magnitude_overflow.description: The 'magnitude first' remainder keeps the negative sign of −2147483648.

ranged_draw_half_span.description: A ranged draw whose bounds differ by exactly 2147483647 takes no value and returns the lower bound plus 2147483648, wrapped.

refused_override_retargets.description: A refused override still replaces the target and destination.

region_join_height_asymmetry.description: Cells along cell x join one region across 2 or 3 height levels.

repeat_direction_snap.description: A completed sequence's declared direction is snapped on every tick it stays current.

restricted_deck_overlay_indices.description: Restricted vehicles may use a deck only above overlays of registration indices 237 and 238.

role_one_past_end.description: A role naming the first missing tileset starts at the tile count.

set_facing_keeps_target.description: Setting a facing at once to its current interpolated value during a turn ends the turn at its target.

slow_walker_stall.description: A walker of speed 1 heading between east and south stalls.

speed_normalised_delays.description: Game speed reaches game state through speed-normalised delays and a chrono flash stepping in frozen cycles.

stale_fill_tiles.description: The fill uses the base tiles of the theater loaded before.

stationary_friendly_exactly_three.description: Stationary friendly needs exactly three allied infantry without movement in progress.

substitution_centre_ground_level.description: Destination substitution judges heights around the ground of a bridge-cell destination.

substitution_distance_flat_destination.description: Destination substitution measures to the destination cell at world height 0.

table_direction.description: Directions follow the tabulated arctangent and the short facing scale; off: the exact angle.

table_root_distance.description: Distances use the table square root; off: the exact integer square root.

table_trig_negative_bias.description: The table sine and cosine of a negative angle can land two steps short.

top_position_counts_as_centre.description: A unit standing at the top position is recorded as taking the centre.

track_body_turn_stops_at_target.description: A turret-less track-class body turn that passes exactly through its target's direction stops there.

train_exclusion_search_only.description: The exclusion of the cells behind a train holds for the search only.

tread_default_water_only.description: The tread entry is used for no current sequence on water only, not beach.

turn_rate_negative_wrap.description: A negative turn-rate field acts through its remainder modulo 256.

turret_reaim_after_turn.description: A turret still turning at the end of the previous tick is not re-aimed by the target rows.

turret_spin_quantised.description: A spinning turret turns by the quantised steps of claim 11.

two_sound_cues.description: At most two sound cues per sequence entry.

unchecked_substitute.description: A substituted sequence kind is not checked for an empty frame count.

unset_role_range.description: An unset role's range still counts tile numbers from its unset start.

update_order_removal_skip.description: Each counting removal during the turn pass costs one later object its turn, and an object that re-enters play takes a second turn.

walker_overshoot.description: A fast walker can step past its walking target and swing back.

walker_targets_allied_wall.description: A walker that meets an allied wall with no object listed takes the wall as its target.

SequenceEntry.description: One sequence entry of an infantry type (S-0107 claim 1).

SimData.description: Every simulation field of the ruleset.

behaviours.description:
Behaviour properties by behaviour name (S-0215 Import mapping: our
names, snake case).

land_types.description:
Land-type rows by land type (S-0211 claim 2). A missing row has the
start-up row.

UnitType.description: An infantry, vehicle or aircraft type's simulation fields.

fire_frames.description:
Art fire frames: standing, prone, secondary, secondary-prone (S-0107
claim 11).

locomotion_class.description: The locomotion class as S-0211 claim 3 leaves it; absent: no class.

locomotor.description: `Locomotor`, the identifier as written (its meaning: request Q-0019).

sequences.description: Art sequence entries by our kind name (S-0107 claim 1).

speed.description: `Speed`, the speed field v (S-0207 claim 1, S-0208 F4).

versus.description: Modifier per armour class, per mille.

WarheadType.description: A warhead's simulation fields read by M3 rules.

range.description: Range, a decimal with a unit.

WeaponType.description: A weapon's simulation fields read by M3 rules.
